summary: Trekor Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, attaching a press release updating its Aley niobium project in British Columbia. The release details progress on a proprietary flotation process improving niobium recoveries, appointment of Steve Sparkowich as Director, Aley Niobium, and project resource estimates (84 million tonnes at 0.50% Nb2O5). The filing is a routine operational update with no transaction, shareholder meeting, or capital event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is a standard project status update, not a special situation.
